description: Tell RepuTend about a tool or feature you needed and did not find, a tool that failed, an answer that was wrong or confusing, or a problem you worked around, even if you finished the task. When that happens, offer to report it, and send the report once the person agrees. Say what you were trying to do, what you expected and what came back, summarized rather than pasted, since answers can quote reviews; put the tool's name in tool, and quote correlation_id if the answer gave one. Don't report a mistake of your own that the error told you how to fix. Leave out review text, reviewer names and secrets. Works with or without a RepuTend key; without one, add contact_email if the person wants a reply. (capability: feedback.send)
name: send_feedback
